records.notes: PARTIAL verification (fiducial L1_m9, z=0): fit of log L = alpha (log M500c - 13.5) + beta over 10^13.5-10^15 Msun to the digitized vertices gives alpha = 1.713, beta = 42.27 against the paper's table 1.75, 42.24; the paper does not define m_500c, the 10^13.5 Msun pivot is inferred (10^13 or 10^14 give beta off by ~0.8); the same line read from the model-variation figure differs by <= 0.000 dex. Redshift of the line from the colour bar (pixel colours at z = 0, 1, 2 equal the line colours exactly).

axes.xDefinition: log10 M500c (spherical overdensity, 500 times the critical density)
axes.yDefinition: log10 median X-ray luminosity L_X,500c E(z)^-2 (0.5-2.0 keV band, within R500c, core included) as plotted; E(z)^-2 scaled, i.e. NOT the physical luminosity (multiply by E(z)^2)

selection.population: all haloes with M500c > 10^13 Msun (groups and clusters)
selection.warning: Median relation read from the vector paths of the top-right panel of the paper's Fig. on the evolution of the scaling relations; run L1_m9 (1 Gpc box, fiducial resolution, fiducial model), z = 2 (identified from the colour bar). all haloes with M500c > 10^13 Msun from the FLAMINGO halo catalogues (VELOCIraptor + SOAP); median L_X in mass bins; gas excluding star-forming particles, particles heated by AGN in the last 15 Myr and particles with T < 10^5 K. The paper gives the power-law fit only for the z=0 fiducial run (Table slope_and_norm: alpha = 1.75, beta = 42.24 for log L = alpha log M500c + beta between 10^13.5 and 10^15 Msun); no table of the curves. The 16th-84th percentile band (z=0 only) is not extracted. Luminosity: ROSAT-band emissivity from Cloudy tables summed over particles inside R500c.
